A better approach would’ve been: - **Quietly putting your phone away** (if you didn’t want to engage). - **Asking politely** if you could step out (e.g., "I’m not feeling well, can I leave early?"). - **Accepting the consequence** (e.g., missing class, talking to your teacher later). --- ### **3.
